validity.recommendation: Check the 70.25 km length against the 71 km and 67 km sources, and check that the capacity of 0.22 billion cubic meters a year is meant as the hourly design flow annualized, not the 21.3 million cubic meters of the federal decree.
validity.researcher_notes: Three open points. The length of 70.25 km matches no source, which give 71 km and 67 km. The capacity of 0.22 billion cubic meters a year equals the 25 thousand cubic meters per hour design flow run for a year, while the federal decree gives 21.3 million cubic meters a year. The newest wiki citation is June 2023 and says construction was about to start, so the operating status rests on the sheet's own refs.

verifications.note: Article of 13 June 2023, read in full. Says construction of the Andreevskaya to Ingaly and Bolsherechenskaya branch starts in mid 2023.

fills.researcher_notes: No wiki citation names the owner of this pipeline. The owner on the sheet stays as it is. Not searched this pass.

The wiki citations date from 2017 to June 2023 and describe design, permits and a planned construction start in mid 2023. None of them shows the line in service. The sheet's own refs were not part of this pass.

The 2017 Omsk Oblast decree 195-p names this branch and gives future design flows of 5.7 thousand cubic meters per hour for Ingaly and 19.3 for Bolsherechenskaya, 25 thousand in total. Run for a full year that is about 219 million cubic meters, which is 0.22 billion. The federal decree 3326-r of 2021 gives a planned annual volume of 21.3 million cubic meters for the same branch. That is a different measure and about ten times smaller. Both figures are in the row note.

verifications.note: Omsk Oblast decree 195-p of 13 July 2017, read in full. The title names the branch from the Andreevskaya station to Ingaly and Bolsherechenskaya with future flows of 5.7 and 19.3 thousand cubic meters per hour.

fills.researcher_notes: The 2021 Omsk Oblast program gives 71 km and the 2021 Omsk Oblast planning scheme gives 67 km. No source gives 70.25 km. The sheet value stays because the two sources disagree with each other. Not searched beyond the wiki citations this pass.
The Omsk Oblast planning scheme, edition of June 2021, lists the branch from the Andreevka station to the Ingaly and Bolsherechenskaya stations with pipe diameter D325, which is 325 mm.

verifications.note: Omsk Oblast planning scheme, edition of June 2021, read in full. Branch from Andreevka station, diameter D325.
